privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seo_description: How Optimax Eye Specialist collects, uses and protects your personal data under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act.
privacy.intro: This notice is issued under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act (as amended in 2024). It applies to Optimax Eye Specialist and its group companies, to anyone who uses our services or products, and to visitors to this website.

sections.title: 1. Why we collect your data
sections.body:
We collect personal data to register you as a patient, administer and provide the treatments and services you ask for, communicate with you, process payments and insurance, keep internal records and audits, research treatment outcomes, improve our services and understand our market.

This may include your name, job title, company, contact details, visit and website activity, demographics, gender, age and date of birth.

sections.title: 2. How we collect it
sections.body: We collect data when you visit our clinics, register with us, call or email us, or contact us in other ways. By giving us your information, you consent to it being processed for the purposes above.

sections.title: 3. Who we share it with
sections.body:
We may share data with third parties in or outside Malaysia where the law requires it, under contract, or for the purposes above. These include auditors, lawyers, vendors, contractors and insurers; government and regulatory bodies; accreditation bodies (such as ISO and MSQH); cloud and hosting providers; peer-review consultants; employers (for employment screenings); and anyone you have consented to.

We do not sell, rent or lease patient information.

sections.title: 4. How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep personal data only for as long as it is needed for the purposes it was collected for.

sections.title: 5. Accessing your data
sections.body: You may ask for a copy of your personal data in writing, specifying the data you need. A fee may apply. We'll verify your identity with your NRIC and/or driving licence.

sections.title: 6. Correcting your data
sections.body: We take reasonable steps to keep your data accurate, complete and up to date. Corrections are free: write to us with the incorrect and correct information, your name, NRIC and home address.

sections.title: 7. If information is incomplete
sections.body: Please keep your information accurate and update us when it changes. Some information is mandatory — if it's withheld, we may not be able to register you or provide services.

sections.title: 8. Marketing
sections.body: We may use your data to tell you about our services, promotions and prize draws. We only send marketing emails and SMS if you opt in, and you can unsubscribe at any time through the link in our messages, your account profile, or by contacting us.

sections.title: 9. Other websites
sections.body: We're not responsible for the privacy practices of external websites we link to. Please read their privacy notices.

sections.title: 10. Cookies and web beacons
sections.body: We use cookies to make the site work, understand which sections are popular and personalise your experience. You can control cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work without them. Web beacons may be used on the site and in emails alongside cookies.

sections.title: 11. Security
sections.body: We protect your data with measures including encryption and password protection where appropriate, and by limiting access to authorised employees.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this notice
sections.body: We may update this notice by posting changes on this page. Please check it from time to time. If the English and Bahasa Malaysia versions differ, the English version prevails.
